    if cache:
        cache_path = os.path.join(get_data_home(data_home),

    if name == "titanic":
        df["class"] = pd.Categorical(df["class"], ["First", "Second", "Third"])
        df["deck"] = pd.Categorical(df["deck"], list("ABCDEFG"))

    return df
